dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - May 27, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**MLB Recap: May 27**

In a day filled with home runs, the Seattle Mariners exploded for 9 runs to take down the Athletics 9-1, led by Rob Refsnyder's 3-RBI performance, including a home run. Meanwhile, in the American League East, the Boston Red Sox dominated the Atlanta Braves 8-0, with Jarren Duran hitting his 8th home run of the season. In the National League, the Arizona Diamondbacks edged out the San Francisco Giants 3-2, thanks to Luis Arraez's 2-RBI effort.

On the mound, Logan Gilbert threw a gem for the Mariners, striking out 6 in 6 innings of work. Gerrit Cole was equally impressive for the New York Yankees, fanning 10 in 6.2 innings to lead the Yankees to a 7-0 win over the Kansas City Royals. In the National League, Shohei Ohtani pitched a complete game shutout for the Los Angeles Dodgers, striking out 7 in 6 innings to lead the Dodgers to a 4-1 win over the Colorado Rockies.
